name: HostDime Colombia / Nebula Data Center
notes: Tier IV data center at Zona Franca de Tocancipa, Tocancipa, Cundinamarca. HostDime states construction is complete; facility is 70,000 sq ft and supports over 800 racks. Earlier construction article reported groundbreaking in February 2020 and expected commissioning in early 2021.

name: Ilkari Colombia ILK-COL1
notes: Located in the Tocancipa Free Trade Zone. Ilkari states 800 sq m net technical space, 3.6 MW power capacity, expansion capability to 7 MW, TIA-942-C Rated-3 and ICREA Level IV certifications; ITseller reported inauguration and 548-rack total capacity.

name: Liberty Networks Tocancipa Tier IV Data Center
notes: Impacto TIC reported Liberty Networks' new Tier IV data center in Tocancipa, Cundinamarca, with dual power sources, UPS protection, solar panels for non-critical areas, and 99.995% availability.

name: ODATA / Aligned DC BG01
notes: Aligned lists BG-01 at Zona Franca Metropolitana de Cota, Cundinamarca. DCD reports the facility launched in 2018 and offers 14.6 MW IT capacity across 5,500 sq m.

name: ODATA / Aligned DC BG02
notes: ODATA announced DC BG02 in Zona Franca de Occidente, Mosquera, Cundinamarca, with 24 MW IT capacity. Initial construction phases expected by end-2026 as part of a $1.3B Colombia expansion.

name: ODATA / Aligned DC BG03
notes: ODATA announced DC BG03 in Zona Franca Metropolitana, Tenjo, Cundinamarca, with 120 MW IT capacity. DCD reports it is designed for cloud and AI providers and expected to be Colombia's largest data center on completion.

name: Scala SBOGZB02-SBOGZB03
notes: Scala lists SBOGZB02-SBOGZB03 in Colombia at Zona Franca Bogota, location Bogota | Cundinamarca, with startup date 2024-2027; capacity not disclosed on the source page.

name: Scala SBOGZM01
notes: Scala lists SBOGZM01 at Zona Franca Metropolitana, location Bogota | Cundinamarca, with startup date 2023; source page does not disclose capacity.

name: Scala SBOGZT01
notes: Aggregate listings place Scala SBOGZT01 within Zona Franca de Tocancipa / Zipaquira, Cundinamarca. DataCenterMap reports 5 MW; Baxtel describes it as a planned Tocancipa-region Cundinamarca data center.

name: Claro Data Center Triara
notes: Claro says its Triara ICREA V Gold data center is on the Bogota-Medellin highway and is one of three Claro data centers in Colombia. Third-party listings place Triara at Celta Trade Park, Funza, Cundinamarca and report 25 MW.

name: Ascenty Bogota data center campus
notes: Ascenty lists two Colombia data centers serving Bogota with 20 MW total power and 18,500 sq m total area; aggregate listings place Ascenty Bogota 2 within Zona Franca Occidente, Mosquera, Cundinamarca.

name: Digital Realty Bogota BOG2
notes: Digital Realty lists two Bogota data centers, including BOG2 with 96,000 sq ft / 8,900 sq m colocation space. Datacenters.com places BOG2 at Zona Franca de Occidente, Mosquera, Cundinamarca; no power capacity was available from the verified sources.
